verses.1: And Hothar shall come out from the descendants of Isai, and his descendants shall be destroyed.
verses.2: And the Spirit of Jehovah would rest upon him. It was a spirit of wisdom and understanding; a spirit of counsel and power; a spirit of knowledge and awe before Jehovah.
verses.3: And he shall smell it in the sight of Jehovah, but his eyes shall not see it. His ears shall not hear it either.
verses.4: And he judges fairly among the poor, and he vindicates the rights of those who are oppressed in the land. With his words and with the blow of his lips, he kills the wicked.
verses.5: And justice will be his reward, and truth will be the source of his salvation.
verses.6: And a fox lives with a hedgehog; and a hedgehog lives with a rabbit. They all live together, along with a donkey, a scorpion, and a hare. A little boy also lives among them.
verses.7: And the sheep and the goats will be gathered together. Their children will grow up, and the lion will eat them like breakfast.
verses.8: And Sh’e’sh’a Yonik covered the mouthpiece with a cloth, and he also covered the light of his eyes with a hand covering.
verses.9: They shall not harm nor destroy anything in all the holy places. For the earth is filled with knowledge of Jehovah, just as the seas are filled with water.
verses.10: And on that day, Shushan, the city where Nebuchadnezzar stood to rule over the nations, would be filled with joy.
verses.11: And on that day, Adonai will once again extend His hand to acquire the rest of His people who remain in Assyria, Egypt, Phatros, Kush, Eilam, Shinear, Hama, and the islands.
verses.12: And he will carry out his plans among the nations. He will gather together the scattered people of Israel. The Jews will be rescued from the four corners of the earth.
verses.13: And the envy of Ephraim will be destroyed. The enemies of Judah will be defeated. Ephraim will no longer be envious of Judah, and Judah will no longer provoke Ephraim.
verses.14: And they flew together in the wings of Philistia’s birds. They attacked the children of Adam and Eve, as well as the children of Ham.
verses.15: And the Lord made the river of Egypt flow again. He raised His hand over the river in the desert, and it divided into seven streams.
verses.16: And it would be a model for the rest of the people who remained after the fall of Assyria, just as Israel was in that situation on the day they were taken up from the land of Egypt.
